about_the_game:
The official Bunny Space Odyssey: FlopHop Artbook chronicles the project’s journey from the first sketch to the release-ready world. Dive behind the scenes to see how Ponchee, the intelligent suit Usagi-01, and the lonely planet FlopHop grew from rough ideas into a living, breathing universe.

Explore creator commentary, concept iterations, animation breakdowns, and scans from the real development diary. This is a love letter to the process: experiments that worked, happy accidents that shaped the style, and the design decisions that defined the game’s mood, music, and mechanics.

What’s Inside

  • Worldbuilding & Narrative

    • The origins of FlopHop’s themes: loneliness, purpose, resilience.

    • Story beats and cut content, with notes on why things changed.

  • Character & Creature Design

    • Ponchee’s silhouette evolution and expression sheets.

    • Supporting lifeforms: from thumbnail doodles to polished turnarounds.

    Visual Development

    • Styleframes establishing the final look & feel.

      Dev Journal Scans

    • Handwritten pages, graybox maps, bug lists, and production checklists.

    • Early task boards and milestone retrospectives.

  • Bonus Material

    • Unused concepts, “what-ifs,” and playful experiments.

    • High-resolution galleries suitable for wallpapers.

Why You’ll Love It

  • Deep commentary from the creator on how and why decisions were made.

  • Process-first approach - not just pretty pictures, but the messy, honest path to the final game.

  • Aesthetic treasure trove for fans, artists, students, and devs alike.
